title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes
body:
* **Rich text in widget titles and descriptions**: Visualization widget titles and descriptions now support rich text formatting. Click a widget's title or description to open a formatting toolbar, where you can apply text styling, links, and tables, or enter Markdown text directly. See [Format widget titles and descriptions](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/visualizations#format-widget-titles).
* **Hide pivot table column headers**: Dashboard authors can now hide the column header in a pivot table. See [Value-level settings](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/visualizations/tables#pivot-value-settings).
* **Schedule run history**: Dashboard authors can now see the run history for a schedule, including the run ID, start and end times, and status for each of the five most recent runs. See [View schedule run history](/aws/en/dashboards/share/schedule-subscribe#view-run-history).
* **Pivot table grand totals fix**: Fixed a bug where grand totals and expand and collapse controls did not appear on pivot tables.
